Anniversary May 5, 2026

Saint Jean Marc Feast Day & 49th Anniversary

Parish Celebration & Official Group Parade

Duration: Full Day
Eligible Units: All Units (4 – 24) & Families
Location: Paroisse Saint Jean Marc, Se7a Byblos
Assembly: Tuesday, May 5
Members & Leaders Portal (Signed-in Only)

Internal Camp Portal & Documents

Registered scout families and leaders can sign in to view the confidential patrol roster, medical authorizations, real-time camp updates, and private photo drives.

Event Overview

Every year on May 5th, the entire troop, along with alumni from 1977 to the present, gathers to celebrate our patron saint and founding anniversary.

The day begins with the ceremonial inspection and full parade through the medieval souks and harbour of Byblos, followed by the parish high mass.

During the ceremony, new recruits who have completed their probation period pronounce the solemn Scout Promise before the altar and receive their official unit foulard.

Detailed Schedule Highlights

09:30 Uniform inspection and flag bearer assembly in church cloister
10:30 Solemn Parish Mass celebrated by our Archbishop & Aumônier
11:45 Scout Promise ceremony & foulard investitures for all branches
12:30 Group parade through the ancient streets of Byblos
13:30 Community reception and 49th Anniversary fellowship lunch

Required Packing Kit & Equipment

  • ✓ Full formal uniform: freshly ironed scout shirt, badge sash, and foulard
  • ✓ Clean dark navy trousers or skirt
  • ✓ Polished dark shoes or clean boots
  • ✓ Scout beret or fourragère (for squad leaders)
